summary: All WP-006 test requirements already satisfied by tests created during WP-003 through WP-005
test_supervisor.py: 18 tests cover all 12 routing paths from WP-006 table plus safety limit, blocked WPs, IN_PROGRESS prioritization, state updates, and no-LLM guard
test_state.py: 7 tests verify WorkflowState TypedDict structure, operator.add reducers on run_log and errors, and LangGraph StateGraph acceptance
test_graph.py: 9 tests verify 7-node topology, hub-and-spoke edges (graph.nodes + graph.builder.edges), and checkpoint dir creation
test_plan_parser.py: 13 tests cover standard plan, YAML frontmatter stripping, empty/missing headers, missing files, relative paths
147/147 total tests pass; no MCP or LLM calls in any test

comments.note: All WP-006 test files were written organically during prior WPs (test_supervisor.py in WP-003, test_state.py/test_plan_parser.py written as supporting files, test_graph.py in WP-005). WP-006 is a verification/consolidation pass rather than new test authorship.

pytest-cov not installed in this environment; coverage was evaluated by routing path analysis rather than tooling. All 12 routing table rows in WP-006 spec map directly to named test functions in test_supervisor.py. Coverage is estimated at ≥90%.
